correction: Replace with: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <table_name> WHERE <column_name> > ( SELECT <column_name> FROM <table_name> ORDER BY <sorting_column> DESC LIMIT 1 )

metadata.description: This rule corrects a SQL query that incorrectly uses a subquery in the WHERE clause to find the maximum value of a column, which results in multiple rows being returned instead of a single value as required by the COUNT(*) function.
